title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series with Missing Values
study_context: Clinical time series from MIMIC-III and PhysioNet, plus synthetic data.
population_or_data: Clinical time series from MIMIC-III and PhysioNet, plus synthetic data.
task: Clinical time series from MIMIC-III and PhysioNet, plus synthetic data.
method: Recurrent modeling with missingness masks and time intervals.
main_findings: GRU-D incorporates observation masks and time intervals to exploit informative missingness in time-series prediction.
limitations: Selected abstract page only; does not establish benefit of a static stain-presence vector or infer a causal missingness mechanism in SMC.
does_not_establish: Selected abstract page only; does not establish benefit of a static stain-presence vector or infer a causal missingness mechanism in SMC.
relevance_to_project: Interpret presence-mask ablations and rare-positive ranking metrics without claiming a local causal mechanism.
